Instead, stripes span the panel and form a second broad band toward the lower right, so the required pattern is largely incorrect. Knowledge: The supplied symmetry explanation requires the mirrored bottom-left design; the crossing and duplicated bands fail that expectation. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
